en: Black-and-white panoramic view over a semi-industrial European town in a hilly landscape. In the foreground is a factory complex with a tall chimney and multi-storey industrial buildings. A curving road or rail corridor leads through the valley, bordered by modest houses and open fields. In the distance are more residential buildings, several multi-storey institutional-looking blocks, and church-like towers, all set against rolling cultivated hills. Trees frame the image in the front corners, giving it a composed, scenic look typical of early 20th-century postcards.
